conviction_note: Q3 revenue very likely lands above the RMB1,838-1,858M guide (the company beat its own guide top by 0.1%, 2.3%, 5.7% and 4.5% over the last four quarters), but a single-source consensus near RMB1.928B already sits 3.8% above the guide top, the stock was sold -5.75% intraday on the last Q3 print when revenue landed at the top and the Q4 guide decelerated, and peer EDU fell 12.5% on 2026-10-28 on a revenue beat because growth was moderating; so the fundamental read is a modest beat (+2.5% vs guide top) while the reaction leans slightly negative on the Q4 guide, offset in part by a 13% five-day drawdown that is mostly explained by a China-tech selloff and Youdao's 2026-11-19 print. p_up 48 on an abs move of 8%; impact_sum -0.8 and the scaled -0.32 agree in sign.
bar: Company guide Q3 2026 net revenues RMB1,838M-1,858M (+16.4% to +17.7% YoY), from the Q2 2026 release https://finviz.com/news/386002/gaotu-techedu-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results (2026-08-27). print_vs_bar_pct is against the guide top (expected ~RMB1.90B). A consensus of about RMB1.928B revenue and CN¥0.27 EPS appears only in a Chartmill search snippet (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/GOTU/estimates, page itself 403); against that number the expected print is about -1.3%. Earnings-per-share consensus is unsourced or disputed (Macroaxis $0.03 from one analyst; RTTNews lists RMB-0.91, apparently the prior year), so findings that depend on the profit line are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest about 1.99M ADS short, 3.7 days to cover as of the 2026-10-30 FINRA settlement; ORTEX 1.73% of free float, 3.4 days, cost to borrow 0.69% (data 2026-10-19); 1.9M / 3.3 days at 2026-09-30 (search snippets: https://app.ortex.com/s/NYSE/GOTU/short-interest , https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/gotu/short-interest/). Not crowded, so no squeeze mechanism. No skew: the baseline chain is unusable (ATM legs not two-sided, total OI 608, put/call OI 0.01). Tape: spot $2.075, -13.2% over 5 days, -19.3% over 20 days, -26.9% from the 52-week high; the 5-day drop is Nov 19 -5.0% and Nov 20 -9.65% (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/gotu/history/).

findings.finding: Gaotu guides conservatively and has beaten the TOP of its own revenue guide in each of the last four quarters: Q3'25 RMB1,579.0M vs 1,558-1,578 (+0.1%), Q4'25 RMB1,685.3M vs 1,628-1,648 (+2.3%), Q1'26 RMB1,689.5M vs 1,578-1,598 (+5.7%), Q2'26 RMB1,670.1M vs 1,578-1,598 (+4.5%). Q2'26 billings were +19.4% and deferred revenue at June 30 was RMB2,611M (+18.9% YoY), against a Q3 guide of only +16.4-17.7%, which points to Q3 revenue around RMB1.88-1.93B (+19-22%). Against the single-source consensus (~RMB1.928B) this is in line, not a beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 revenue 4.5% above the guide top and above the RMB1.62B consensus: shares +4.05% premarket on 2026-08-27 (https://finviz.com/news/386164/gaotu-techedu-shares-rise-as-q2-revenue-tops-forecasts). Q3'25 revenue at the guide top: shares -5.75% intraday on 2025-11-26 (https://www.itiger.com/news/1115897709). Q4'25 beat: +3.52% on 2026-03-06 (stock price page via search, not verified).
findings.why_not_priced: The guide is RMB1,838-1,858M; if the market held the guide as the bar a ~2-4% revenue beat would surprise. But the one consensus number found (RMB1.928B) already sits 3.8% above the guide top, i.e. the sell-side has priced the sandbagging pattern, so the unpriced part is small. It would look priced if the consensus were the bar; the bar is disputed, hence the small size.
findings.independence: Guide history from separate releases: Q4'25/Q1'26 guide https://finviz.com/news/330332/gaotu-techedu-announces-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-unaudited-financial-results ; Q3'25 guide https://seekingalpha.com/news/4489261-gaotu-projects-q3-2025-revenue-growth-of-up-to-30_6-percent-while-advancing-ai-driven ; Q1'26 guide for Q2 https://finviz.com/news/358713/gaotu-techedu-announces-first-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results . TAL's summer commentary (finding 8) is a separate source pointing the same way.

findings.finding: The stock trades on the next-quarter guide, and Gaotu's next guide will likely read as a deceleration: its guides are deliberately low (the Q1'26 guide was +5.7-7.0% YoY, it delivered +13.2%; the Q3'26 guide +16.4-17.7% followed +20.2% in Q2), and the Q4 comparison base is a strong Q4'25 (RMB1,685.3M, +21.4%). On the Q2 call management gave no full-year target, said growth will be 'profitable growth' with a 'prudent approach to expansion', and said offline sites would be reviewed project by project after summer, so a Q4 guide in the low double digits or below is the base case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3'25 print (2025-11-26): Q4 guide of +17.2-18.7% read as a slowdown from +30.7%, and the stock fell 5.75% intraday despite a narrower loss and a new $100M buyback (https://www.itiger.com/news/1115897709). Q2'26: the Q3 guide's slowdown to +16-18% was noted but the stock still rose ~4% premarket on the beat.
findings.why_not_priced: No Q4 guide or Q4 consensus was found anywhere, so the market's Q4 number is unknown; the stock has fallen 19% in 20 days, which partly discounts a weak outlook. If a low guide were fully priced the stock would not have reacted -5.75% to the same pattern last year; the conservative-guide habit makes a 'deceleration' headline likely even if the business is fine. This is an inference from the guide history, not a document about Q4.
findings.independence: Peers' moderation language: TAL said on 2026-10-29 it 'expects overall revenue growth to moderate further' (https://www.earningswhispers.com/transcript/TAL/Q22027). Shares the Q2 call with finding 7.

findings.finding: The sector's reaction function sells beats when growth moderates: New Oriental reported fiscal Q1 FY27 (Jun-Aug 2026) revenue +23.1%, above the top of its own guide, kept its FY guide of +14-18%, and fell 12.5% on 2026-10-28; GOTU fell 8.17% the same day and another 3.81% on 2026-10-29 when TAL printed +15.5% with a net loss and said growth would moderate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Peer reactions, not GOTU's own: EDU -12.5% on a beat (2026-10-28). GOTU's own Q3'25 print was sold (-5.75% intraday) on a beat with a slowing guide.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a statement about how holders of Chinese edtech react, not about GOTU's numbers; the sector sell-off on 10-28 is already in GOTU's price, but the reaction function (beat + slower outlook = down) is what the print will be met with. If holders were already looking through moderation, EDU would not have fallen 12.5% on a beat.
findings.independence: GOTU's own daily closes on 10-28/10-29 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/gotu/history/); EDU result and guide https://finviz.com/news/409725/new-oriental-announces-results-for-the-first-fiscal-quarter-ended-august-31-2026 . Proxy (peer), sized small.

findings.finding: Youdao (2026-11-19) reported Q3 learning-services revenue down 5.2% YoY to RMB609.4M and said the decline was mainly 'a larger share of summer enrollments taking place in the second quarter', widening its Q3 operating cash outflow by ~RMB30M. If the same shift hit Gaotu, Q3 gross billings (only +11.2% in Q3'25 at RMB1,188.9M) and operating cash flow could print soft even with revenue above guide, and Gaotu's large Q2'26 beat may have borrowed from Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3'25: billings +11.2% against revenue +30.7% and an operating cash outflow of RMB660.2M were cited as reasons the stock fell 5.75% intraday (https://www.itiger.com/news/1115897709). GOTU fell 5.0% on 2026-11-19 and 9.65% on 2026-11-20 after Youdao reported.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: GOTU fell ~14% over Nov 19-20, coincident with Youdao's print and a China-tech selloff. Gaotu guided Q3 revenue on Aug 27 after most of the summer courses had run, so the revenue line is less exposed than billings and cash flow; what is not visible yet is Gaotu's own Q3 billings number.
findings.independence: Youdao release https://finviz.com/news/425003/youdao-reports-third-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results . Peer proxy, unlinked to Gaotu by any Gaotu statement; offset in part by TAL's 'solid' summer demand (finding 8).

findings.finding: Most of GOTU's 13% five-day fall into the print is explained by a broad China-tech selloff, not company news: on 2026-11-19 the Hang Seng fell ~2% to a four-month low and the Hang Seng Tech index fell for a seventh session to a 26-month low (Tencent -7%, Alibaba -5.5%) on renewed US-China trade friction; no Gaotu 6-K, regulatory notice or company news was found for Nov 16-24. The stock enters the print at $2.075, about -27% from its 52-week high and, on ~235M ADS-equivalents (156.7M ordinary shares at 2 per 3 ADS), a market value near $490M against RMB3.99B (~$560M) of cash and investments (before RMB2.6B of deferred revenue).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No GOTU-specific precedent found for a print after a macro-driven drawdown.
findings.why_not_priced: A washed-out tape lowers the bar for a relief move on an in-line print; if the drop had been company-specific there would be a filing or a story, and none was found. This is an inference about positioning, not a fact about the quarter, so sized small.
findings.independence: Daily closes https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/gotu/history/ ; cash and share count from the Q2 release https://finviz.com/news/386002/gaotu-techedu-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results . Shares the Nov 19-20 window with finding 4 (Youdao), which reads the same drop the other way.

findings.finding: Buyback capacity is large relative to the market value: cumulative repurchases were ~US$103.5M (36.5M ADSs, RMB741.8M) under the US$80M 2022 and US$100M 2025 programs as of 2026-08-26, leaving roughly US$76.5M, about 15% of a ~$490M market value; but the pace slowed to ~RMB38M between 2026-06-01 and 2026-08-26 (33.1M to 36.5M ADSs). The print will carry an updated repurchase tally and possibly a new authorisation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3'25 print announced completion of the $80M program and a new $100M program; the stock still fell 5.75% intraday, so buybacks have not carried this print before (https://www.itiger.com/news/1115897709).
findings.why_not_priced: Known program, so mostly priced; the unpriced part is whether repurchases accelerated at the lower Q4 prices or a new program is added. If the market expected an acceleration the stock would not sit at a 20-day low with the program 3/4 unused.
findings.independence: Q1'26 buyback figure (33.1M ADS, ~RMB704M by 2026-06-01) from https://finviz.com/news/358713/gaotu-techedu-announces-first-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results ; peers EDU (fully used $300M, new $200M) and TAL (extended to July 2027) are returning capital, so a sector norm exists.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call (2026-08-27) COO Bin Luo said offline projects would be reviewed 'city by city and project by project after the summer cycle' and the company would 'eliminate projects and sites that we do not see potential to generate right economic returns', so Q3 or the Q4 outlook may carry offline site closures and related impairments or charges.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None found for Gaotu. The path to the multiple runs both ways: closures cut costs (the market rewarded EDU/TAL margin focus) but could also slow offline revenue, which was growing 'high double digits' in H1.
findings.why_not_priced: No quantification exists anywhere; nothing in the price or the coverage refers to it. Sized as a one-off at a fraction of its money, with an ambiguous sign.
findings.independence: Same call reported by https://www.insidermonkey.com/blog/gaotu-gotu-narrows-its-losses-while-a-new-growth-question-emerges-1824497/ (same document, counted once). Shares the Q2 call with finding 2.

findings.finding: TAL, whose fiscal Q2 (Jun-Aug 2026) overlaps Gaotu's Q3 summer season, said on 2026-10-29 that 'demand for face-to-face learning remains solid and student retention remains healthy' and that enrollment growth was the largest contributor to its offline programs' double-digit growth over the summer; New Oriental's education business also beat its own guide for Jun-Aug. Summer demand in the category held up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Peer data, not GOTU's own; see finding 1 for GOTU's response to revenue beats.
findings.why_not_priced: Public for a month, so largely priced; filed because it counters the Youdao read (finding 4) on the summer season and supports the revenue read. Peer proxy, small.
findings.independence: EDU result https://finviz.com/news/409725/new-oriental-announces-results-for-the-first-fiscal-quarter-ended-august-31-2026 . Contradicts finding 4 in direction; both kept small because they are peer proxies.

findings.finding: Operating leverage has been improving through 2026: in Q2'26 selling expenses fell to 54.7% of revenue (-4.4pp YoY), G&A to 11.5% from 13.6%, non-GAAP net loss narrowed 37.6% to RMB129.1M and operating cash inflow rose 46.3%; Q3'25's non-GAAP loss was RMB137.7M, so a materially narrower Q3'26 loss is likely if the trend holds. Against that, Q1'26 non-GAAP income fell to RMB41.4M from RMB137.3M, and the EPS bar is disputed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 adjusted EPS missed consensus (RMB-0.57 vs -0.46) while revenue beat, and the stock rose ~4% premarket, so the profit line has mattered less than revenue (https://finviz.com/news/386164/gaotu-techedu-shares-rise-as-q2-revenue-tops-forecasts). Q3'25 'profitability concerns' were cited for the -5.75% fall.
findings.why_not_priced: The EPS consensus could not be sourced to two agreeing places (CN¥0.27 at Chartmill, $0.03 at Macroaxis, both single-analyst), so whether a narrower loss beats is unknowable; capped small.

A clean record of GOTU's 1-day earnings reactions (only Q3'25 -5.75% intraday, Q2'26 +4.05% premarket, Q4'25 +3.52% unverified were found)

baseline_tension: There is no skew and no reaction history in the baseline; the -13% 5-day and -19% 20-day run-up agree with a cautious read on the guide, while my revenue read (beat vs guide) cuts against it, and both lean small, so p_up sits near 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction) and lesson 6 (single-source consensus): the guide-beat finding cut from +0.8 to +0.5, because the only consensus found already sits above the guide top and the last Q3 print at the top of the guide was sold.

Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0; macro transmission is small): the oversold/positioning finding cut from +0.7 to +0.4, since it is inference about the tape, although the drawdown here is explained by a China-tech selloff.

'Asking what the market missed generates pessimism': guide-deceleration finding trimmed from -1.5 to -1.3 and the EDU peer-reaction finding from -0.7 to -0.6, because both are inferences from the pattern rather than a document about Q4; p_up moved from 47 to 48.

Left standing: the Youdao proxy (-0.5), the buyback (+0.4), the offline one-off (-0.2, already sized as a one-off), TAL summer demand (+0.2) and operating leverage (+0.3, already capped for the disputed EPS bar); abs_move_pct 8.0 unchanged.
